notes.title: Desert Kingdoms 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for your support and feedback over the last months. I am happy to announce that I am currently working on [b]Desert Kingdoms 2[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956730/Desert_Kingdoms_2/

A lot of stuff is still placeholder art and it's still a long way to go but here are some features you can expect in Desert Kingdoms 2.

* Siege Weapons
* Mounted Units
* New Buildings, Town Walls
* Environmental dangers like Sandstorms or tornados
...

I would also like to include full Controller or Steamdeck support, but that's not my priority.

Thanks again and all the best!
Markus

tags.feature: Environmental dangers like Sandstorms or tornados
